actionable_sentences: The API name must be "QueryMeeting" (case-insensitive matching is acceptable).

All required parameters must be supplied: token (string), meeting_topic (string up to 50 characters), start_time (string in %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S format), end_time (string in %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S format), location (string up to 100 characters), and attendees (list of strings).
lifted_nl: The QueryMeeting API shall use the identifier "QueryMeeting" for its reference, allowing case-insensitive matching during validation.
The QueryMeeting API shall require a token parameter of type string.
The QueryMeeting API shall require a meeting_topic parameter constrained to a maximum of 50 characters.
The QueryMeeting API shall require a start_time parameter formatted according to the pattern YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
The QueryMeeting API shall require an end_time parameter formatted according to the pattern YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
The QueryMeeting API shall require a location parameter constrained to a maximum of 100 characters.
The QueryMeeting API shall require an attendees parameter expressed as a list of strings.
operations.LABEL: FUNCTIONAL_SPEC
operations.Precondition: All required parameters (token, meeting_topic, start_time, end_time, location, attendees) must be provided with correct types and formats. token is a string, meeting_topic is a string ≤ 50 characters, start_time and end_time are strings matching YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, location is a string ≤ 100 characters, and attendees is a list of strings.
operations.Function: query_meeting(token: str, meeting_topic: str, start_time: str, end_time: str, location: str, attendees: List[str]) -> dict
operations.Postcondition: The API returns a JSON object with meeting_info as the top-level result containing the queried meeting details.
assumptions: The system has network connectivity to the QueryMeeting API endpoint.
Authentication tokens are properly generated and valid.
Date strings conform to the specified YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
invariants: If the API call succeeds, the returned meeting_info contains the requested meeting details.
All input parameters passed to the API are within their specified constraints.
